notes: Policy for scripts/regression_gate.py. Changing this file loosens or tightens the gate, so it is reviewed like code.
gated_runs: the runs CI checks. Their committed evidence must come from the current code (behaviour fingerprint), and must not regress against the base branch.
max_regressions: how many cases may go from right to wrong. Set from measured run-to-run noise (DECISIONS.md D28), not by feel.
accepted: deliberate regressions, each with a reason. Remove an entry once the baseline has been updated; the gate lists entries that no longer match anything.

renamed: runs and suites that were renamed, mapped to their names on older commits, so the gate compares a renamed run with its predecessor instead of treating it as new. Safe to delete once the base branch has the new names.
